newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury urges more open UK food industry.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury urges more open UK food industry.

text.p: Britain's food industry must improve communication with its customers to restore confidence in quality and safety, J. Sainsbury Plc chief executive designate Dino Adriano said on Tuesday.
Adriano told a retailing industry conference that consumer confidence in food safety was at a very low point.
"Consumer confidence in food integrity has fallen to the point where it is beyond mere secrecy, cover-ups and ineptitudes."
He said the industry had to act to restore confidence. "We have to be clearer, franker and more accountable for the goods that we sell."
Adriano said the recent outbreaks of E-coli food poisoning in Scotland were a terrifying reminder of what could happen if things were not done properly.

He said consumers needed to know more about the products on sale to restore trust and to close a "yawning gap" of information which currently existed. This would give consumers the ability to make choices and rebuild confidence.
